claims.text: Apply a target profile
claims.note: Tile title. Target Profiles ships on production: the settings menu entry is live (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:55) and every slot has an Apply Profile action (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:213-218).

claims.text: Switch the whole course between saved strategies.
claims.note: Tile summary. Profiles are kept per Lynx course (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:181-189), and applying one writes every matching station of that course (SpatialAdjustService.cs:861-936).

claims.text: Save a full set of station targets under a name, then switch the whole course between seasonal and event strategies in one action.
claims.note: Update from Current stores the Target VWC of every station in the course (SpatialAdjustService.cs:566-580, :653-671) under the slot's editable name (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:204), and Apply Profile switches the course to it on Save Changes. "Under a name" means one of five fixed, renameable slots (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:103-109, :383-392), not a new entry.

claims.text: Settings › Target Profiles
claims.note: The Settings gear in the toolbar opens the dialog (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:68-72); Target Profiles is the third entry in its left rail, after Calculation and Minimum Threshold (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57).

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab lists five profile slots for each Lynx course, named Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter and Tournament until you rename them, with Last Updated, Stations, Update from Current and Apply Profile columns.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (target-profiles/note/1); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Target Profiles is still in development and is not in the shipping build yet — the screens below show a proposed design, which the tab being built does not yet match.

claims.text: If your settings dialog has no Target Profiles entry, your IntelliDash has not yet been updated to the release that includes it.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (target-profiles/note/1); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The push, settings and announcement dialogs open over the dashboard from the toolbar (:94-112); the guide starts with none open.

claims.text: A saved profile: a slot that shows a station count, not --.
claims.note: An empty slot shows -- for Last Updated and Stations and its Apply Profile icon is disabled; a saved profile shows a station count (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:205-206, :214).

claims.text: A profile stores one Target VWC per station.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. Update from Current stores one TargetVwcPct per station name for the course (SpatialAdjustService.cs:653-671); a multi-sprinkler station is one entry.

claims.text: It does not store percent adjustments or enable states.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; 373-1135 rev 02 predates Target Profiles and the source settles it. A stored row holds the profile id, the station name and a Target VWC only (SpatialAdjustService.cs:662-667). Applying writes Target VWC and recalculates today's suggestion; it changes no enable state and leaves any % Adj. override in place (:921-936).

claims.text: Applying a profile changes the target of every station it holds a value for, which recalculates their suggestions; stations not in the profile keep their targets.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (target-profiles/before/3); docs/text-corrections.md §14 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Applying a profile changes targets on every station, which recalculates every suggestion.

claims.text: Open Settings
At the right of the toolbar, select the gear button, [[Settings]].
claims.note: The gear button has tooltip STRINGS.SETTINGS "Settings" and opens the Settings dialog (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72).
claims.previousText: Profiles sit alongside Calculation and Minimum Threshold in the settings dialog, because a profile is a calculation input rather than a station edit.

claims.text: The Settings dialog opens, with a rail of tabs down its left side.
If another dialog is open, close it first.
claims.note: Dialogs here are modal (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:3), so a second dialog cannot be reached while one is open.

claims.text: The gear is just right of [[Announcements]].
The gear button sits in the toolbar’s right-hand group.
Open the Target Profiles tab
claims.note: Step title. The rail entry is "Target Profiles".

claims.text: In the left rail, select [[Target Profiles]], below [[Minimum Threshold]].
claims.note: The rail lists Calculation, Minimum Threshold, Target Profiles, then Preferences (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims target-profiles/note/1, target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Each profile shows when it was last updated, by renaming it or with Update from Current, and how many stations it holds.

claims.text: The right side lists 5 profile slots, with [[Update from Current]] and [[Apply Profile]] columns.
claims.note: Five slots per course, indexes 0 to 4 (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:28-31, sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:383-392). Column headings at sa-settings-dlg.component.html:195-199.
claims.previousText: The profile you applied is named above the dashboard table, as “Summer Target Profile” for a profile named Summer; changing any station target afterwards leaves the stored profile intact but removes that label.

claims.text: If the rail has no [[Target Profiles]], your IntelliDash predates it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Change targets in the table instead.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab in the settings dialog.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (target-profiles/1/3); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Proposed Target Profiles tab in the settings dialog.

claims.text: Read the profile list
claims.note: Step title. The list is a table of five slots.

claims.text: Find the profile in the [[Target Profile]] column.
claims.previousText: Applying overwrites the Target VWC of every station the profile covers.

claims.text: Its row shows when it was last updated and how many stations it holds.
claims.previousText: Because that is a recalculation input, the dashboard reloads and the Suggested column changes across the course.

claims.text: If both read --, the slot is empty and cannot be applied.
claims.note: An empty slot reads -- under Last Updated and Stations, its Apply Profile icon gets the disabled class, and onApplyTargetProfile returns early when stationCount < 1.

claims.text: Fill it first: see Capturing profiles.
claims.note: Cross-reference to the guide on capturing a profile. The Update from Current icon is the control that fills a slot.
claims.previousText: Before a tournament. Apply the profile the evening before, review the suggestions the next morning, then push.

claims.text: Five profile slots; an empty slot shows -- for Last Updated and Stations.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (target-profiles/2/4); docs/text-corrections.md §12 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Three profiles: one active, one seasonal, one never applied.

claims.text: Choose the profile
claims.previousText: Save your current targets into a profile slot

claims.text: On the profile’s row, select the icon under [[Apply Profile]].
claims.previousText: Once the course is tuned the way you want it, save the state as a profile so you can return to it.

claims.text: The [[Use Target Profile?]] dialog opens, with a count of [[Matching Stations]].
claims.note: The confirmation is titled SPATIAL_ADJUST.USE_TARGET_PROFILE "Use Target Profile?" and its summary table has a SPATIAL_ADJUST.MATCHING_STATIONS "Matching Stations" row (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:272-314).

claims.text: If nothing opens, you may have cleared an earlier choice on that row.
claims.note: onApplyTargetProfile toggles: when the row is already marked it clears the mark and returns without opening the dialog (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:257-261).

claims.text: Select the icon again.
claims.note: A second selection after clearing opens the confirmation (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:263-265).

claims.text: A profile applies course-wide, changing [[Target VWC]] on every station it holds, so check the [[Suggested]] column before you push.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims target-profiles/3/2, target-profiles/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard. Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review.

claims.text: Applying a profile is a course-wide change.
claims.note: Course-wide per Lynx course: a site with several courses keeps a profile set for each.

claims.text: Caution. A profile matches stations by name, so a station renamed or renumbered after capture will not match when an old profile is applied.
claims.note: Caution tip for the profile apply step. A profile stores station names and matches by trimmed, case-insensitive name within its course (production SpatialAdjustService.cs); stored names with no current station are skipped and stations not in the profile are not touched. Expert confirmed in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough.

claims.text: A station added after capture keeps its target.
claims.note: Applying a profile only touches the stations it holds. A profile stores station names and matches by trimmed, case-insensitive name within its course (production SpatialAdjustService.cs); stored names with no current station are skipped and stations not in the profile are not touched. Expert confirmed in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough.

claims.text: Confirm the profile
In the [[Use Target Profile?]] dialog, select [[Confirm]].
claims.note: The dialog confirm button is STRINGS.CONFIRM "Confirm" (uppercased on screen) and calls onApplyProfile (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:276-279).

claims.text: The dialog closes, and an exclamation mark on the icon shows the profile will be applied on save.
claims.note: Confirming sets applyProfile on the chosen slot and closes the dialog; the exclamation icon has tooltip "Will be applied on save" (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:216).

claims.text: If there is no exclamation mark, the choice was canceled.
claims.note: Cancel closes the dialog and leaves applyProfile unset (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:281-285), so no mark appears. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Select the icon under [[Apply Profile]] again.
claims.note: A second selection on a marked row clears the mark (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:257-261); a further selection then opens the confirmation again (:263-265).

claims.text: Stations in the profile that are no longer scanned are skipped, which is why [[Matching Stations]] can be lower.
claims.note: The dialog warns when matching stations differ from the stations saved in the profile and says "Matching stations will be updated, while unmatched stations will be ignored." (SPATIAL_ADJUST.PROFILE_UNMATCHED_STATIONS_WARNING).

claims.text: A chosen profile waits for Save Changes.
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.USE_TARGET_PROFILE_INFO says the replacement happens when you save; the mark is only a flag on the dialog until onSave sends it.

claims.text: Save the change
Select [[Save Changes]] at the bottom of the dialog.
A busy sign shows while the profile is applied, then the dialog closes and the dashboard reloads.
claims.note: onSave sets isBusy, which shows the waiting indicator (html:45), waits for the queued profile operation to finish, then reloads the dashboard through saBulkAdjustCompleted and closes (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:201-209, :543-546).

claims.text: If the dialog stays open with [[Unable to save data]], the save did not finish.
claims.note: On error onSave shows the generic save error, GENERIC_SAVE_ERROR_SUMMARY "Unable to save data", and does not emit save, so the dialog stays open (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-213).

claims.text: Reload the page and check the profile list before you try again.
claims.note: The profile operation can fail or time out after ten minutes with advice to refresh before trying again (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:510-518); a failed save does not reload the list, so reloading is the way to see what was stored.

claims.text: Nothing is applied until Save Changes.
Check the new targets
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/verify/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: In the table, read [[Target VWC]] on a few stations.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/verify/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: They match the profile.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/verify/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The name above the table reads, for example, Summer Target Profile.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/verify/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If the name is missing, a target was edited after you applied the profile.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims target-profiles/2/3, updating-profiles/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The stored profile is unchanged.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims updating-profiles/1/3, updating-profiles/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: [[Suggested]] has recalculated too, so read it before you push.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/verify/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Targets and suggestions after the profile is applied.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims target-profiles/verify/2, target-profiles/verify/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The dashboard names the applied profile above the table.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (target-profiles/verify/1); docs/text-corrections.md §13 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The applied profile is marked active in the list.

claims.text: Target VWC in the table matches the profile you applied.
claims.note: For every station named in the profile, after the dashboard reloads. Stations not in the profile, and any station with no adjustment record, keep their targets (SpatialAdjustService.cs:901-915).

claims.text: Suggested percentages have recalculated against the new targets.
claims.note: Today's suggestion is recalculated where today's adjustment exists (SpatialAdjustService.cs:921-924). % Adj. overrides are not reset.
